name: The Fool
upright: New beginnings, a leap of faith, innocence.
essence: a first step taken in the dark, with nothing left to lose
reversedEssence: a blind step toward a drop no one warned you of
counsel: Step forward, even unready; the forsaken roads reward the bold.
reversedCounsel: Look down before you leap. Not every fall has a bottom.

name: The Magician
keywords: the power to make things happen
upright: Will, skill, the power to make things happen.
essence: a will strong enough to bend what the gods abandoned
reversedEssence: power turned to trickery, a sleight of hand meant for you
counsel: Use what lies in your hands; no one else will act for you.
reversedCounsel: Watch the hands of those who smile at you.

name: The High Priestess
essence: a secret kept behind a veil no god guards anymore
reversedEssence: a truth you refuse to hear, though it keeps whispering
counsel: Be silent and listen; what you seek is already whispering.
reversedCounsel: Stop ignoring the voice inside you. It has been right before.

name: The Empress
essence: a harvest that grows even on forsaken ground
reversedEssence: a garden left to wither, care withheld
counsel: Tend what is yours, and it will feed you.
reversedCounsel: Something you love has been neglected. Go back to it.

name: The Emperor
essence: an iron rule, order kept by a firm hand
reversedEssence: a tyrant's grip, or a throne left empty
counsel: Hold to your discipline; it is a wall against the chaos.
reversedCounsel: Beware of those who mistake control for strength, yourself among them.

name: The Hierophant
essence: an old creed, kept long after its gods fell silent
reversedEssence: a broken vow, a rite that no longer holds
counsel: Seek out those who came before; their ways still have something to teach.
reversedCounsel: Do not follow a rule only because it is old.

name: The Lovers
upright: Union, a choice of the heart, harmony.
essence: a bond sworn in the dark, and a choice of the heart
reversedEssence: a bond fraying, a choice made against yourself
counsel: Choose with your heart, then stand by your choice.
reversedCounsel: Look at what you are bound to, and ask whether you still want it.

name: The Chariot
reversed: Lack of direction, defeat, being pulled apart.
essence: a will driving forward through ash and ruin
reversedEssence: a charge without direction, the reins slipping
counsel: Take the reins and do not look back.
reversedCounsel: Slow down. Strength without direction only ends in a ditch.

name: Strength
essence: a quiet courage that tames the beast
reversedEssence: a courage gone hollow, and the beast let loose
counsel: Be gentle with what frightens you, and it will bow to you.
reversedCounsel: Your doubt is a beast too. Do not feed it.

name: The Hermit
essence: a lantern carried alone through the long dark
reversedEssence: a solitude that has turned into exile
counsel: Withdraw for a while; answers come to those who walk alone.
reversedCounsel: You have been alone too long. Let someone in.

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright: Fate, cycles, a turn of luck.
reversed: Bad luck, resistance to change, broken cycles.
essence: the turning of fate, which neither gods nor mortals can stop
reversedEssence: a turn of bad luck, the wheel grinding downward
counsel: Ride the turn of fate; it cannot be stopped, only met.
reversedCounsel: What goes down comes up again. Endure.

name: Justice
essence: a debt that will be paid, in full
reversedEssence: a judgement twisted, a debt left unpaid
counsel: Be honest in your dealings; the scales are watching.
reversedCounsel: If you have wronged someone, make it right before it is made right for you.

name: The Hanged Man
essence: a sacrifice that lets you see the world upside down
reversedEssence: a waiting that has rotted into stagnation
counsel: Let go of what you cannot hold, and look again.
reversedCounsel: Stop waiting for a sign. This is the sign.

name: Death
upright: An ending, transformation, clearing the way.
reversed: Clinging to the past, stagnation, a change resisted.
essence: an ending, cold and certain, that clears the ground
reversedEssence: an ending you refuse, rotting where it stands
counsel: Let what is dead stay buried; mourn it, then move on.
reversedCounsel: Clinging to what is over will not bring it back.

name: Temperance
essence: a careful balance, water poured from cup to cup
reversedEssence: excess, and a balance lost
counsel: Take the middle path; patience will mend what haste would break.
reversedCounsel: Measure your appetites before they measure you.

name: The Devil
reversed: Release, breaking chains, facing a vice.
essence: a chain you forged yourself, and the hunger that holds it
reversedEssence: a chain loosening, a hunger finally named
counsel: Name what binds you; only then can you break it.
reversedCounsel: You are nearly free. Do not reach back for the chain.

name: The Tower
reversed: Disaster averted, fear of change, delayed ruin.
essence: a ruin that strikes without warning and lays the truth bare
reversedEssence: a disaster narrowly avoided, or merely delayed
counsel: Brace yourself, and let what is false fall.
reversedCounsel: The cracks are showing. Mend them now, or step away.

name: The Star
essence: a faint light still burning where the gods abandoned the sky
reversedEssence: a hope dimmed, faith worn thin
counsel: Keep your hope; even in a forsaken sky, a star remains.
reversedCounsel: Your light is not gone, only hidden. Look for it.

name: The Moon
reversed: Truth surfacing, confusion lifting, deception revealed.
essence: an illusion born of fear, shapes moving in the dark
reversedEssence: a fog lifting, a fear seen for what it is
counsel: Trust nothing you see by moonlight; wait for the dawn.
reversedCounsel: What frightened you was smaller than its shadow.

name: The Sun
reversed: Clouded joy, delay, a dimmed light.
essence: a rare light breaking through, warm and clear
reversedEssence: a light clouded over, a joy delayed
counsel: Step into the light while it lasts; you have earned it.
reversedCounsel: The sun is behind the clouds, not gone. Be patient.

name: Judgement
reversed: Self-doubt, a call ignored, harsh judgement.
essence: a reckoning, and a call you cannot ignore
reversedEssence: a call unheeded, a reckoning put off
counsel: Answer the call; the dead do not wait forever.
reversedCounsel: You know what you must face. Stop looking away.

name: The World
reversed: Unfinished business, a missing piece, delay.
essence: a circle closed, a long road walked to its end
reversedEssence: a road left unfinished, one step short of the end
counsel: Finish what you have begun; the end is near.
reversedCounsel: One last step remains. Do not stop now.

name: The Fool
upright: New beginnings, a leap of faith, innocence.
essence: a new road taken under an unknown sky
reversedEssence: a road taken without a map, toward a cliff edge
counsel: Set out; the stars will find you on the way.
reversedCounsel: Before you set out, ask where the road leads.

name: The Magician
keywords: the power to make things happen
upright: Will, skill, the power to make things happen.
essence: the skill to draw down the light of the stars
reversedEssence: a gift wasted, or a trick dressed up as starlight
counsel: You hold every tool you need. Begin.
reversedCounsel: Not every shining thing is a star. Look closer.

name: The High Priestess
essence: a secret written in the stars, read only by the patient
reversedEssence: a sign you have seen and refused to read
counsel: Read the signs quietly; they are already there.
reversedCounsel: You have seen the sign. Stop pretending you haven't.

name: The Empress
essence: a season of plenty, fields ripening under a kind sky
reversedEssence: a dry season, a field left untended
counsel: Plant now; the season favours you.
reversedCounsel: Care for yourself as you care for others.

name: The Emperor
essence: a steady hand at the helm, a course held true
reversedEssence: a course held too rigidly, or no course at all
counsel: Set your course and hold it.
reversedCounsel: A captain who never changes course runs aground.

name: The Hierophant
essence: the wisdom of those who charted the stars before you
reversedEssence: an old map that no longer matches the land
counsel: Ask those who walked this road before you.
reversedCounsel: The old maps are wrong here. Draw your own.

name: The Lovers
upright: Union, a choice of the heart, harmony.
essence: two paths meeting, and a choice of the heart
reversedEssence: two paths drifting apart
counsel: Walk beside the one who walks beside you.
reversedCounsel: If your paths have parted, let them.

name: The Chariot
reversed: Lack of direction, defeat, being pulled apart.
essence: a swift journey, carried forward by sheer will
reversedEssence: a journey stalled, wheels stuck in the mud
counsel: Ride on; the road is yours.
reversedCounsel: Rest the horses before you drive them into the ground.

name: Strength
essence: the calm courage of one who has walked far
reversedEssence: a weariness that saps the will
counsel: Endure gently; the road is long, but you are strong.
reversedCounsel: Even the strongest traveller must rest.

name: The Hermit
essence: a lone traveller following a single star
reversedEssence: a traveller lost, too proud to ask the way
counsel: Follow your own star, even alone.
reversedCounsel: Ask for directions; there is no shame in it.

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright: Fate, cycles, a turn of luck.
reversed: Bad luck, resistance to change, broken cycles.
essence: the turning of the heavens, fortune changing with the seasons
reversedEssence: a bad turn of the heavens, luck running against you
counsel: The sky turns in your favour; act while it does.
reversedCounsel: Bad seasons end. Wait for the next one.

name: Justice
essence: a fair road, where every step is weighed
reversedEssence: an unfair toll, a scale tipped against you
counsel: Walk straight, and you will arrive.
reversedCounsel: Someone is cheating you, or you are cheating yourself.

name: The Hanged Man
essence: a pause on the road, the world seen from another angle
reversedEssence: a pause that has lasted too long
counsel: Stop and look up; the stars look different from here.
reversedCounsel: You have rested long enough. Move.

name: Death
upright: An ending, transformation, clearing the way.
reversed: Clinging to the past, stagnation, a change resisted.
essence: the end of one road, and the crossroads beyond
reversedEssence: a road you will not leave, though it ends here
counsel: Let this road end; another begins at your feet.
reversedCounsel: You cannot walk a road that is gone.

name: Temperance
essence: a steady pace, neither hurried nor halted
reversedEssence: a pace lost, haste and delay by turns
counsel: Keep a steady pace; you will arrive in time.
reversedCounsel: Find your rhythm again before you go on.

name: The Devil
reversed: Release, breaking chains, facing a vice.
essence: a comfortable inn you cannot bring yourself to leave
reversedEssence: a door opening, the road calling you out of a gilded cage
counsel: Remember why you set out, before comfort keeps you.
reversedCounsel: The door is open. Walk through it.

name: The Tower
reversed: Disaster averted, fear of change, delayed ruin.
essence: a bolt from a clear sky, the road torn up ahead
reversedEssence: a storm passing just beside you
counsel: When the road breaks, find another; it will be shorter than you think.
reversedCounsel: The storm passed close. Do not tempt it twice.

name: The Star
essence: the guiding star itself, clear and bright above the road
reversedEssence: a guiding star hidden by cloud
counsel: Follow your star; it has not led you astray.
reversedCounsel: The clouds will part. Keep walking.

name: The Moon
reversed: Truth surfacing, confusion lifting, deception revealed.
essence: a road lit only by moonlight, where nothing is as it seems
reversedEssence: the moon setting, and the way growing clearer
counsel: Walk carefully at night, and trust your feet over your eyes.
reversedCounsel: The path is clearing. You will soon see where you stand.

name: The Sun
reversed: Clouded joy, delay, a dimmed light.
essence: a bright morning, and a road open in every direction
reversedEssence: a grey morning, the warmth a little delayed
counsel: Go out into the day; it is yours.
reversedCounsel: The day is still good, even if it started grey.

name: Judgement
reversed: Self-doubt, a call ignored, harsh judgement.
essence: a call from beyond the horizon, too loud to ignore
reversedEssence: a call you pretend not to hear
counsel: Answer the call; it will not come again.
reversedCounsel: You heard it. Go.

name: The World
reversed: Unfinished business, a missing piece, delay.
essence: the journey's end, the whole sky turned full circle
reversedEssence: the last mile, still unwalked
counsel: You have arrived; look back at how far you have come.
reversedCounsel: Walk the last mile. It is always the longest.
